name: WhatsApp Small Business Lead Qualifier
description: Collects a small set of relevant lead details on WhatsApp, scores basic fit using transparent rules, and routes qualified conversations to a human seller.

steps.description: Explain what information will be collected and ask the person to continue voluntarily.
Ask only the approved qualification questions and validate each response before continuing.
Apply documented rules to classify the lead without using sensitive personal characteristics.
Send qualified leads to the correct human seller and provide a respectful next step to others.

privacy.notes: Store only necessary lead fields, restrict access, define a deletion period, and never use sensitive traits for scoring or routing.

testing: Complete the flow with a qualified test lead and confirm the correct seller receives the summary.
Decline consent and verify that no personal lead information is stored.
Provide an invalid response and confirm the workflow asks for correction without entering a loop.
